title: data_validation step configuration (architecture section 4)
description: Rules by type, an optional stage (a profile may compose this pattern more than once, for example pre- and post-transform), threshold and on-failure policy. A rule takes exactly one of two forms, never both and never neither: a field rule, which names the field it constrains, or a reconciliation rule, which proves coverage against the upstream contracts a consolidated product consumes (architecture section 8, 'a consolidated product proves its coverage with a Data Validation occurrence whose rules reference its upstream contracts'). A reconciliation rule names at least two upstream contracts; that they are contracts this product actually consumes is enforced in ergasterion/framework/graph.py, where the estate's whole source set is known.
